name: Christmas Trees
overview: Scripture presents trees in both symbolic and practical contexts, highlighting their use in worship and celebration while cautioning against idolatry. Leviticus 23:40 instructs the taking of boughs from goodly trees as part of rejoicing before the Lord, whereas Deuteronomy 16:21 forbids planting groves near God's altar to prevent pagan practices. The prophetic passages in Isaiah point to the coming Messiah, described as a Branch from Jesse's lineage, emphasizing the true source of hope and peace rather than earthly symbols. Thus, biblical teaching calls believers to focus on Christ, the promised Immanuel and Prince of Peace, rather than on physical trees as objects of worship.
